home.strengthsTitle: Strengths of IN WOOD interior doors

strengths.title: Maximum factory preparation
strengths.text: Lock mortising at the factory, pre-drilled hinge seats, frame rebate cut-in, 45° frame mitring, precise geometry of every element — fully ready for fast installation.

strengths.title: Custom sizes in 50 mm steps at no extra charge
strengths.text: Width at no extra charge: 600–900 mm (50 mm steps). Height at no extra charge: 1800–2100 mm. Maximum height — up to 2300 mm for an additional fee.

strengths.title: Frame made of combined material (solid pine + MDF)
strengths.text: Pine gives the frame rigidity and reliability, while MDF provides a perfectly even surface for a quality finish — the frame resists deformation for many years.

strengths.title: Thick 6 mm MDF layer
strengths.text: Increased rigidity of the door leaf, resistance to deformation and a longer service life.

strengths.title: Kiln-dried timber frame
strengths.text: Structural strength and durability of the doors even after many years of use.

strengths.title: Dense 18 mm honeycomb infill
strengths.text: Better stability of the construction and the door leaf overall.

strengths.title: Aluminium edge trim (flush installation)
strengths.text: Reliable protection against impacts, chips, moisture and mechanical damage.

home.installTitle: Fast installation of IN WOOD doors: thanks to maximum factory preparation
home.installText: IN WOOD doors arrive on site fully ready for installation: lock already mortised, hinge seats pre-drilled, frame mitred at 45° — the installer only needs to assemble and align it. No extra on-site adjustments — only precise factory dimensions.
home.installResult: Result: installation is fast, accurate and without the risk of damaging elements on site.
home.aboutText: IN WOOD is a Ukrainian manufacturer of interior doors with its own production facility in Poltava. We create modern doors for apartments, houses, offices and commercial premises using quality materials and modern production technology. Our products are available across Ukraine through a network of official dealers and are also exported abroad.
home.commercialText: IN WOOD is a reliable manufacturer of interior doors for hotels, aparthotels, offices and residential complexes. We produce serial batches, work to construction schedules, and guarantee consistent quality, on-time delivery and professional project support.
home.collectionsSubtitle: Freedom to realise design ideas with IN WOOD doors

collections.name: ETALON
collections.text: ETALON panel interior doors embody minimalism and versatility. A composite panel decorates each model in this series while setting the tone for a restrained style. The PVC film finish is easy to maintain.

collections.name: NOMINAL
collections.text: A range of minimalist panel doors with a light design. They bring harmony and complement the interior of living or working spaces.

collections.name: FREZZATTI
collections.text: Balanced geometry, refined style and depth of choice — that's what the FREZZATTI collection offers. A wide palette of PVC films and the option of RAL/NCS colour matching expand the horizons of design solutions.

collections.name: PERFETTO
collections.text: These doors are about elegance and flawless form. High-quality glass options and RAL/NCS colour matching give complete freedom of choice.

home.hiddenDoorsText: A modern solution for minimalist interiors. The door leaf is installed flush with the wall, creating a "hidden door" effect. The INSIDE opening type ensures a neat opening into the room.
home.techText: IN WOOD door leaves and frames are made from a combination of solid wood and MDF, ensuring high strength, structural stability and a long service life.

garantiya.title: IN WOOD door warranty — terms for dealers and partners
garantiya.heading: Warranty
garantiya.intro: We stand behind the quality of every door that leaves our production — from materials to hardware. Below are the warranty terms for dealers and export partners.

sections.title: Standard warranty
sections.text: IN WOOD interior doors carry a 1-year warranty from the shipment date. The warranty covers manufacturing and material defects, provided storage, transport and installation guidelines are followed.

sections.title: Hardware warranty
sections.text: The warranty on hardware (hinges, locks, handles, etc.) is set by the hardware manufacturer under its own warranty terms and is stated in the accompanying documentation for the batch.

sections.title: Warranty conditions
sections.text: The warranty applies provided the recommendations on storage, transport, installation and use are followed. A warranty claim requires the supply agreement and invoice.

sections.title: Warranty repair
sections.text: If a defect is found within the warranty period, the partner contacts their manager or calls +38 050 880 38 41 to file a claim report. Repair or replacement is free of charge unless the defect results from a breach of transport or use conditions.

garantiya.procedureIntro: To file a warranty claim, the partner provides:
procedure: the contract or delivery note number
a description of the defect with photo evidence
the date and circumstances of the defect discovery
exclusions: damage caused by a breach of transport or storage rules
damage caused by factors beyond the manufacturer's control (room humidity, improper installation, etc.)
garantiya.ctaText: Have questions about warranty terms or want to file a warranty claim? Leave your contacts — our manager will get in touch and advise on next steps.
garantiya.metaDescription: IN WOOD interior door warranty terms for dealers and partners — coverage, duration and the claims process.

faq.title: FAQ about IN WOOD doors
faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.intro: Answers to the most common questions about IN WOOD interior doors — manufacturing, sizes, materials, installation and warranty.

items.q: How long does it take to manufacture IN WOOD interior doors?
items.a: Standard interior doors take 30 days to manufacture. Custom sizes take 45 days.

items.q: What are the standard sizes of IN WOOD interior doors?
items.a: Width: 600–900 mm; height: 1800–2100 mm.

items.q: Does IN WOOD make interior doors in custom sizes?
items.a: IN WOOD manufactures interior doors in custom sizes in 50 mm steps at no extra charge: width — 650, 750, 850 mm; height — 1850, 1950, 2050 mm.

items.q: How do I correctly measure the door opening before ordering?
items.a: Measure the width, height and wall thickness at several points, since the opening may be uneven. For an accurate order, we recommend using a professional measurement service that will account for all installation details.

items.q: When is the best time to install interior doors during a renovation?
items.a: Interior doors are recommended to be installed at the final stage of renovation — after finishing the walls, ceiling and floor. This helps avoid damage to the door leaves and ensures accurate installation of casings and hardware.

items.q: Can interior doors be installed after the renovation is finished?
items.a: Yes, installing interior doors after the renovation is complete is possible. The main requirement is that the door openings are prepared to the required dimensions and the walls and floor have finished surfaces.

items.q: What materials are IN WOOD interior doors made of?
items.a: IN WOOD interior doors are made with a frame of solid wood and MDF.

items.q: Which door finish is better: PVC film or paint?
items.a: The choice of finish depends on usage conditions and the desired design. PVC-film finish is practical, moisture-resistant and easy to maintain. Painted doors have a more premium look, a wide colour palette, and allow more complex design solutions.

items.q: What's the difference between panel and stile-and-rail ("tsarga") interior doors?
items.a: Panel doors have a solid construction with a smooth surface or decor (moulding, milling, mirror inserts, etc.). Stile-and-rail doors are made by joining solid-wood vertical stiles of the door leaf together with horizontal rails (tsargas).

items.q: How thick are IN WOOD interior doors?
items.a: IN WOOD manufactures interior doors in 34 mm and 40 mm thickness.

items.q: What filling is used inside interior doors?
items.a: IN WOOD panel doors are filled with a fine-cell honeycomb infill (18 mm cell), which ensures uniformity, flatness and rigidity of the door leaf.

items.q: Are IN WOOD interior doors resistant to moisture and damage?
items.a: Sealed leaf edges and an aluminium edge trim provide extra protection against moisture and damage.

items.q: Does the door finish fade or lose colour in the sun?
items.a: IN WOOD door finishes are resistant to sunlight.

items.q: What glass is used in IN WOOD stile-and-rail doors?
items.a: IN WOOD's stile-and-rail door series use satin or black glass.

items.q: Can IN WOOD interior doors be painted in any colour from the RAL and NCS catalogues?
items.a: IN WOOD can paint doors in any colour available in the RAL / NCS catalogues.

items.q: Can I order interior doors taller than 2100 mm?
items.a: The maximum door leaf height is 2300 mm (2150–2300 mm for an additional fee).

items.q: What are flush (hidden) installation doors?
items.a: Flush installation doors are interior doors with an aluminium frame that is installed flush with the wall, staying invisible after finishing, with two opening options — standard and inside. Such doors create the effect of a single plane with the wall and complement modern interiors beautifully.

items.q: What are the advantages of flush installation doors?
items.a: Flush installation doors create a modern, minimalist interior look thanks to being installed flush with the wall. They visually enlarge the space and allow the leaf to be painted or finished in the same style as the walls.

items.q: What hardware does IN WOOD fit its interior doors with?
items.a: IN WOOD fits its doors with hardware from AGB, PALADII, Anselmi and MVM.

items.q: Can I buy just the door leaf, without the frame and casing?
items.a: Yes, at IN WOOD you can purchase just the door leaf, without the accompanying frame and casing set.

items.q: Does IN WOOD install interior doors?
items.a: The company's specialists carry out door installation by arrangement with the client, depending on the order volume.

items.q: How do I properly care for IN WOOD interior doors, and which products should I use?
items.a: IN WOOD interior doors are low-maintenance — simply wipe the surface regularly with a soft, damp cloth and use neutral cleaning products without abrasives or harsh chemicals. This helps keep the finish, colour and flawless look of the doors for years to come.

items.q: What warranty applies to IN WOOD interior doors, and what does it cover?
items.a: IN WOOD interior doors carry a 1-year warranty from the shipping date. The warranty covers manufacturing and material defects, provided storage, transport and installation guidelines are followed.

items.q: Does IN WOOD operate across all of Ukraine?
items.a: IN WOOD delivers interior doors across Ukraine and works with a network of official partners in many towns and cities.

items.q: Which interior doors will last for many years?
items.a: All IN WOOD interior doors are made from quality materials using modern production technology, ensuring their durability, reliability and flawless appearance over many years of use.
